Mamita deserves a Michelin Star!
May 2025 • Solo
Mamita would not be out of place in the Latin Quaters of Paris. The setting is European high end bistro. The vibe is joyous and sincere. The owner, Jade, set with me for a few of the stunning 8 course tasting menu. For just US$43, the Michelin level plates are best I have experienced since Anan in Ho Chi Minh City. The most outstanding dish was the rare beef in fish sauce. It stuck in my mind for days. I had to return a week later to order it as main course. Turns out Mamita makes their fish sauce from scratch with their aged fish in the dryer. If they sell them in a bottle, I would order it by the box. Another outstanding offering was Mamita's curated selection of natural wine. Nothing tastes as good once you've tried it. If Michelin ever bestow its attention on Nha Trang, Mamita's will be the first star on the board.

An oasis of comfort and aesthetics in noisy and simple Nachang
Mar 2025 • Friends
Dinner with a friend, she invited me to this place. After a long arrival in Vietnam, you get very tired of local Phoe Bo soup and street food, and this restaurant and kitchen for me has become an Oasis of refined cuisine, a pleasant and cozy atmosphere , great service.
I took shrimp salad and local fish, and I liked the serving, the taste of the dishes and the wine that the owner advised me.
I had a good dinner and a break from the noise, pleasant and unobtrusive service, a good selection of wines and an intimate atmosphere made my evening.
I recommend those who are tired of local food and want to have a gastronomic pleasure with a good mood.
